_note: Training-camp intel pulled from ESPN's 32 team beat-writer camp notebooks + league news feed + injury report on Aug 5-6, 2026 (the two days before Ethan's draft). This is NOT a ranked board — it's situational reasoning (depth-chart battles, holds-in, injuries, role changes) so entries deliberately have no 'overall' and no 'posRank' (cast zero vote in the board's consensus rank; they only add reasoning to the research prompt). Absence from this file means the player's camp situation wasn't flagged as notable, NOT that he was ranked low. This file goes stale fast — camp battles resolve daily, so treat entries as a snapshot, and re-pull if drafting more than ~1 week later.
_source: ESPN team camp notebooks (site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/news), ESPN injuries feed, and NFL.com/CBS/NBC coverage of the Stefon Diggs signing. Pulled live Aug 5-6, 2026.

kenneth walker iii.note: Signed with Kansas City this offseason and is the projected starting RB there, expected in the huddle with Mahomes' other first-team starters. This is a team change — discount any analyst rank that predates it.

stefon diggs.note: Signed with Washington Aug 5 (one-year, ~$12M). Pairs with Terry McLaurin, not a replacement for him — target competition rises for McLaurin but he remains the team's alpha WR per beat coverage.

terry mclaurin.note: Remains Washington's clear top receiver even after the Diggs signing; described as the team's veteran leader who mentors younger WRs after practice. Target share likely dips some with Diggs added, but he is not falling to a bottom-WR2 outlook.

zach charbonnet.note: On PUP recovering from Feb ACL surgery with no return timetable given by the coaching staff. With Kenneth Walker III gone to KC, Seattle's backfield touches are split between George Holani, Jadarian Price and Emanuel Wilson — no clear lead back yet.

jahmyr gibbs.note: Missed 6+ straight practices in a contract hold-in; also had a back issue flagged during a conditioning test. Bijan Robinson's $75M extension (see below) is expected to set the market and likely speeds up Gibbs' own deal, but as of Aug 5 he has zero camp reps.

bijan robinson.note: Signed a 3-year, up to $75M extension Aug 4-5 after a 5-day hold-in — now the highest-paid RB in the NFL. Still being ramped up gradually in practice, no 11-on-11 reps yet as of the signing.

justin jefferson.note: Minnesota's QB job is a real open competition: Kyler Murray has taken over the majority of first-team reps (16 of 22 snaps in one practice) and is pushing the ball downfield more aggressively than J.J. McCarthy, going a perfect 3-for-3 targeting Jefferson in one session. If Murray wins the job, it's an upgrade to Jefferson's outlook vs. a McCarthy-led offense.

a.j. brown.note: Explicitly described by New England beat coverage as the team's 'clear-cut No. 1 receiver' after the trade. Romeo Doubs (signed for $68M) is lining up as the clear No. 2 alongside him.

romeo doubs.note: New England's WR2 behind A.J. Brown per beat coverage, signed for $68M this offseason. Missed one practice (personal), which opened reps for Kayshon Boutte.

devonta smith.note: Explicitly the Eagles' 'now-No. 1 receiver' in the post-A.J.-Brown-trade offense. Missed a practice with a hamstring injury, no long-term concern reported.

dontayvion wicks.note: Ex-Packer now Philadelphia's WR2 behind DeVonta Smith. Sirianni has publicly compared him to Keenan Allen and has had the camp's standout catches for the Eagles.

deandre hopkins.note: Reported to Patriots camp in a coaching capacity, not as a player, per Vrabel. Any rank still counting him as an active roster piece is stale.

elijah arroyo.note: SLEEPER: Seattle's TE2 as a rookie (15 catches on 26 targets, 179 yards, 1 TD) but has been the single most talked-about player at Seahawks camp through 7 practices — 3 TDs in one session including a one-on-one fade and a team-period score from Darnold. Beat writer's framing: whether Darnold has enough weapons 'is not one of them — especially if Arroyo emerges in Year 2.'

roman wilson.note: SLEEPER: was a healthy scratch down the stretch of 2025, but is drawing more camp praise than any other Steelers pass-catcher from both Aaron Rodgers and DK Metcalf. New coach Mike McCarthy is explicitly planning to expand his role from primarily slot to also outside, citing his 'vertical speed.'

ricky pearsall.note: Season-ending knee (PCL) surgery announced Aug 5 — remove from consideration entirely.

chris brazzell ii.note: Season-ending LCL surgery announced Aug 6 (Panthers rookie WR) — remove from consideration entirely.

rashee rice.note: Kansas City's 'No. 1 receiver' per beat coverage, back at camp after May knee surgery (loose debris removal) but visibly fatiguing by the end of practice periods — expect a gradual workload ramp, not full Week 1 usage right away.

malik nabers.note: Practicing and says he 'felt great,' but as of Aug 5 still not participating in full team drills while recovering from a serious knee injury requiring multiple surgeries. Giants' passing offense has looked pedestrian without him.

tank dell.note: Made his first padded practice appearance since Week 16 of 2024 (multiple torn ligaments, dislocated kneecap) — limited participation, coach says 'on the right plan,' not being rushed. Late-round dart, not a bet on immediate volume.

jayden higgins.note: Houston's real camp story in Year 2 — Stroud predicted a 'dominant' season for him and beat coverage says it's showing, including winning contested catches against an All-Pro corner (Stingley) in practice.

mike evans.note: Missed practice time with a quad strain; San Francisco's top 4 WRs (Evans, Pearsall, Kirk, Stribling) were simultaneously unavailable on at least one practice day, opening reps for Deebo Samuel.

deebo samuel.note: Getting expanded offensive reps at San Francisco camp specifically because Evans/Pearsall/Kirk/Stribling have all missed time simultaneously — an opening beyond his usual return-game role.

brashard smith.note: Surprise No. 2 RB behind the first-team offense at Chiefs camp, ahead of veteran Emari Demercado — Reid specifically praised his pass-catching and route running.

jeremiyah love.note: Rookie RB alternating first-team reps with Tyler Allgeier at Arizona camp; Trey Benson (back from a season-ending 2025 knee injury) is also in the mix. Three-way backfield muddle, avoid paying a premium for a clear lead role.

kyler murray.note: Currently winning the Minnesota QB competition on reps and downfield aggression vs. J.J. McCarthy as of Aug 5 — see Justin Jefferson note. Battle is not settled, watch for a starter announcement before/at draft time.

chris olave.note: Signed a contract extension Aug 5 after a brief hold-in; expected to be a full participant going forward. Cleared of offseason blood-thinner restrictions from a 2025 blood clot.

jordyn tyson.note: New Orleans rookie WR (1st round) stepping up participation alongside Chris Olave; had a TD in red-zone work. Previously limited by hamstring issues, worth watching his usage ramp.
